title: Holding Several Professional Services Projects Engagements
content:
A client may hold any number of Professional Services Projects engagements at once. There is no limit on the number of engagements one client may hold.

## The rule

Each engagement stands under its own statement of work, its own engagement class, its own schedule and its own invoices. Nothing is pooled between engagements, with two exceptions only:

1. the rule on the client's standing across all its engagements, under which an invoice past due on one engagement can stop kickoff or resumption on another; and
2. the credit of an accepted Assessment Engagement's fee against a follow-on statement of work of the same client.

## Points of judgement

- **Is the class of one engagement affected by another engagement of the same client?** No. Each statement of work is classed on its own.
- **Do the invoices of two engagements share one balance?** No. Each engagement keeps its own invoices; only the two exceptions above look across engagements.
- **Is a second or third engagement refused because the client already holds one?** No. The number of engagements a client holds is not limited.

Hypothetical illustration: a client holding a Standard Project and an Advanced Project at the same time has two statements of work, two schedules and two separate sets of invoices.
